<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Boing</id>
    <version>1.1.0</version>
    <authors>Drew Noakes,Krzysztof Dul</authors>
    <requireLicenseAcceptance>false</requireLicenseAcceptance>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <icon>logo-square-512px.png</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/drewnoakes/boing</projectUrl>
    <description>A simple library for 2D physics simulations in .NET.</description>
    <copyright>Copyright Drew Noakes, Krzysztof Dul 2015-2020</copyright>
    <tags>Physics simulation Physics Physics engine Physics simulation library Simulation</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/drewnoakes/boing.git" commit="ba27ddc611986c0106e25c7665d013ca29cf598c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETFramework3.5" />
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard1.0">
        <dependency id="NETStandard.Library" version="1.6.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
    <frameworkAssemblies>
      <frameworkAssembly assemblyName="System" targetFramework=".NETFramework3.5" />
    </frameworkAssemblies>
  </metadata>
</package>
